chunks: Even before them the people of Noah, 'Ad, the mighty Pharoah,
ai.seo_question: Who are the three major nations mentioned as denying their prophets before the time of Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the archetypal pattern of arrogance and denial, specifically linking Pharaoh's tyranny to the concept of 'Dhul-Awtad' (Possessor of Pegs), symbolizing immense power and fortification. This serves as a theological precursor to the Ahl al-Bayt's suffering, illustrating how divine authority is often rejected by those entrenched in worldly dominance, a theme central to the narrative of Imam Husayn at Karbala.
